name: Sofya
desc: Web tools for AI agents: search the web, fetch pages as clean markdown, extract structured data with AI, and run deep multi-source research.

actions.name: search
actions.description: Search the web and get full page content, not just snippets.

actions.name: fetch
actions.description: Fetch URLs and return clean markdown. Supports web pages, PDFs, and documents.

actions.name: extract
actions.description: Use AI to pull specific data from a webpage — pricing, specs, contacts, and more.

actions.name: research
actions.description: Research any topic — searches up to 30 sources and synthesizes a cited report.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
